summary: Vivakor, Inc. filed an 8-K under Items 7.01 and 8.01 announcing two developments: a $72 million crude oil transaction through its Vivakor Supply Trading platform, representing $6 million/month in volume extending through May 2027; and a reset of the payment date for its special dividend of Adapti, Inc. shares to June 30, 2026. No board recommendation, advisors, or structural details are provided. The filing is a routine disclosure of commercial operations and a dividend date adjustment, not a special situation such as an acquisition, divestiture, or activist campaign. What to watch: dividend payment execution and crude oil market dynamics.
